header: What shipped in the platform this quarter

items.title: Funnels can branch on any event property
items.description: A funnel step can now split on a property instead of forcing one path: compare card and invoice checkouts side by side without building two reports. Existing funnels keep their current behaviour.

items.title: Cohort exports past 5 million rows no longer time out
items.description: Retention exports above roughly 5 million rows failed after 300 seconds. They now stream to a signed download link and finish in the background. Brannen Health reported this one.

items.title: The v1 track endpoint has been retired
items.description: Events posted to the old /v1/track path are rejected from this release. Move to /v2/events, which takes the same payload plus a workspace key in the header. SDKs from 3.0 upwards already use it.
